environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-11900KF (8 cores, 16 threads), threads used: 16

timing: One untimed warmup; median of 3 runs up to 10^4 points and 2 at 10^5 (min/max in sealed-result.json). single-run-trace.log.gz is a separate traced single run (observer inside the timed region) showing per-iteration policies and landmark growth.

rigid_nystrom_vs_auto.1000_points: 23.3 ms vs 29.0 ms (Nystrom never pays at this size: exact Auto choice without the fast Gauss probe)
rigid_nystrom_vs_auto.100000_points: 128.5 s vs 197.6 s (1.54x); 3.39x faster than dense

outcomes.parity: max registered-point delta 6.6e-10 against the reference at 10^4 (rigid), 1.2e-8 against dense at 10^5 (rigid), <= 6.0e-10 against low-rank auto (nonrigid); RMS to truth unchanged to 3 significant digits
outcomes.policy_split_100000_rigid: 8 Nystrom iterations (landmarks growing 256 -> 1024), 13 dense, 27 truncated (traced single run)

limitations: The Nystrom error is an a-posteriori estimate on 64 sampled rows, not a bound (the worst row was within about 3x of the estimate on the unit fixtures). The middle sigma phase remains dense. One host, one fixture.
not_measured: Memory peak; cross-host timings; other fixtures.
